title: capilupi1545 and vittoria1686: Camillo Capilupi 1545 (catalogue 1565) and Vittoria Gonzaga 1686-91 (catalogue 1570), both read in part, cc. 48 and 49r not read (contributed by WAINUT)
alfonso1576, ercole1559: Este ciphers (catalogue 1566), 1576 letter read from a ciphertext-only break, 1559 letter read in part as a transcription job, Ariosto c. 1 not solved (contributed by WAINUT)

ferdinand1552: Ferdinand I to Castaldo, 15 Oct 1552 (catalogue 1332), cipher read with a key from the sister glosses, 3 glossed letters not transcribed; overlaps the held castaldo1552, please decide before merging (contributed by WAINUT)
lopezmendez1819: López Méndez to Bolívar, 29 Jan 1819 (catalogue 1523), 15 cipher words read in part, partial table only (contributed by WAINUT)
testi1630: Francesco I d'Este to Ottavio Bolognesi, 1630-1636 (catalogue 1567), 7 letters read with a key from a later clear copy, c. 13r in part, 5 unread (contributed by WAINUT)

ercole1544: Cardinal Ercole Gonzaga to Ferrante Gonzaga (catalogue 1556), key recovered from the July 1544 pairs, two letters read in part, c. 175r decoded, not read; catalogue 1554, seven letters in the same cipher decoded, not read (contributed by WAINUT)
ferrante1549: Charles V and Prince Philip to Ferrante Gonzaga (catalogue 1560, 1561), one key recovered, 14 Nov 1549 read in part (contributed by WAINUT)
mendoza1548: Diego Hurtado de Mendoza to the bishop of Arras (Granvelle), Rome, 29 May 1548, cipher letter read, key rebuilt (catalogue #1268, BNE MSS/20212/29/1)
eugenie1859: French report, f15r read, codebook revised (242 groups)
